title: Utility Transfer Deposit Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:transfer deposit_usd=*
| stats sum(deposit_usd) as total_value, avg(deposit_usd) as avg_value by utility_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks utility type values by total and average deposit amount across utility transfer events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `deposit_usd` values for each utility transfer event and review total and average deposit amount by utility type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total deposit amount.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which utility type shows the biggest deposit amount numbers in your utility transfer data.
